topics.title: COP31 talks enter a crucial fifth day
topics.summary: Delegates at the COP31 climate summit in Antalya are continuing negotiations on climate action, finance and energy as the conference reaches its fifth day.
topics.discussionPrompt: Big summits can feel far away. What local change would make climate action feel real to you: better buses, cheaper home energy, more shade trees, or something completely different?

topics.title: Energy chief says the world is in an electricity age
topics.summary: The head of the International Energy Agency said the world has entered an age of electricity, as electrification becomes more central to energy systems and climate discussions.
topics.discussionPrompt: If daily life runs more and more on electricity, which upgrade sounds most appealing: quieter streets, easier charging, smarter homes, or appliances that cost less to run?

topics.title: Wood-burning smoke study raises indoor-air questions
topics.summary: A new study suggests children’s exposure to pollution from home wood-burning may be as significant as exposure to traffic exhaust, adding to debate about household heating.
topics.discussionPrompt: A crackling fire feels cozy, but clean air matters too. What makes a home feel comfortable to you without sacrificing fresh air?

topics.title: Electric transport reshapes everyday routines
topics.summary: Reports from highly electrified countries describe how electric cars, scooters and motorbike taxis are becoming ordinary parts of travel and household budgeting.
topics.discussionPrompt: Would an electric scooter, bike, car, or bus change your routine most? Or would you rather see better sidewalks and trains before more vehicles?

topics.title: European leaders meet in Dublin on Ukraine and AI
topics.summary: European leaders gathered in Dublin for talks that include Ukraine, possible peace negotiations and artificial intelligence, as they consider how to coordinate their approach.
topics.discussionPrompt: When a group has to speak with one voice, what helps most: one clear spokesperson, lots of listening first, shared facts, or a good mediator?

topics.title: Australia win opening ODI against England
topics.summary: Australia beat England by seven wickets in the first men’s one-day international after debutant fast bowler Mahli Beardman took six wickets for 24 runs.
topics.discussionPrompt: A debut performance like that is a movie moment. What do you think helps someone stay calm when their big first chance finally arrives?

topics.title: Germany watches a potential first female president
topics.summary: Former helicopter engineer Ilse Aigner is being discussed as a possible candidate to become Germany’s first female president, with cross-party support reported.
topics.discussionPrompt: What background would you love to see more leaders bring into public life: engineering, teaching, medicine, art, hands-on trades, or something else?

topics.title: Pope Leo receives a warm welcome in Peru
topics.summary: Pope Leo was welcomed enthusiastically in Peru during a visit that residents and officials described as a major public occasion.
topics.discussionPrompt: When a famous visitor comes to town, what actually makes the event memorable: the crowd, local food, music, a surprising speech, or the stories afterward?

topics.title: Book world talks about a wave of literary scams
topics.summary: Writers are reporting a rise in fake film deals, invitations from book groups and publicity offers, prompting fresh attention to scams targeting aspiring authors.
topics.discussionPrompt: If you were helping a friend spot a too-good-to-be-true offer online, what quick check would you suggest first?

topics.title: Artificial reef project continues off Florida
topics.summary: The historic liner SS United States is beginning a new chapter as an artificial reef off Florida, where it is expected to become a habitat for marine life and a future dive site.
topics.discussionPrompt: Turning an old ship into a reef is such an inventive second life. What other retired structure would you redesign for nature or community use?
